entries.title: Hard Drive Platter and Read/Write Head Dance
entries.description: A spinning reflective disk with concentric colored data tracks is scanned by a hovering read/write head that glides, dips, and pulses light as it writes and erases tiny glowing bits that appear and disappear on the surface.

entries.title: Neural Memory Network Formation
entries.description: A floating cluster of semi-transparent neuron spheres grows branching dendrite tubes that reach, collide, and snap into glowing synapse links whose brightness represents memory strength and slowly fades unless reactivated by passing pulse particles.

entries.title: Warehouse of Moving Memory Crates
